It is the responsibility of the user to familiarise themselves with the data privacy policies and Terms of Use of any GenAI platform they intend using.

The EU’s Artificial Intelligence Act, which is due to come into force over the next few months, has classified some uses of AI in education as high risk and emphasises the importance of human oversight of AI systems.

GenAI models are trained on large volumes of data, very often appropriated from the Internet without the permission of the original creator. This may infringe upon copyrights and intellectual property rights.
